description: This file contains unit tests for the AcknowledgementAggregatorActor class in the org.eclipse.ditto.services.models.acks package. It uses the Akka actor testing framework and JUnit to verify the actor's behavior for handling acknowledgements in different scenarios such as single responses, error responses, header retention, duplicate acknowledgements, and connectivity headers. The tests ensure correct responses and message handling in a simulated actor system context.
external_methods: Child actor creation via Props and getAcknowledgementAggregatorProps()
